title: Insightful Investor: Luke Sarsfield Discusses What Is and Isn’t Changing in Private Markets
summary: Ridgepost Chairman and CEO Luke Sarsfield joined Alex Shahidi on the Insightful Investor podcast to discuss finding alpha in private markets.
body_markdown:
Ridgepost Capital Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Luke Sarsfield recently joined Alex Shahidi on the Insightful Investor podcast to discuss finding alpha in private markets.


Luke discussed Ridgepost Capital’s perspective on why the middle and lower-middle market remains a compelling area of focus and how complementary investment strategies, shared insights, relationships, and institutional knowledge create differentiated sourcing and underwriting advantages across the platform.


[Listen to the podcast.](https://insightfulinvestor.org/episode/-135-Luke-Sarsfield-Finding-Alpha-in-Private-Markets.html)
